meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 用 Astropy 进行天文与天体物理数据分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是天文学家或天体物理学家，需要处理天文数据。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are an astronomer or astrophysicist working with astronomical data.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 Astropy 库来处理天文学数据,如坐标转换、单位换算、读写 FITS 文件、宇宙学计算、时间与表格操作等,并会按 Astropy 的 API 风格生成代码。
howto.when: 当任务涉及实现或调试天文数据分析代码,需要用到 Astropy 时触发,例如坐标转换、FITS 文件读写、宇宙学计算等。

say.text: 用 SkyCoord 把 ICRS 坐标转为银道坐标
say.note: Claude 会写出转换代码并输出结果。

say.text: 读取 image.fits,打印头信息和图像均值
用 Planck18 计算红移 2 的共动距离
say.note: Claude 会调用 cosmology 模块返回距离值。

howto.what_en: With the skill, Claude uses the Astropy library for astronomical data work: coordinate transforms, unit conversions, FITS I/O, cosmology calculations, time and table handling, and WCS operations, generating code in Astropy style.
howto.when_en: Triggered when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code that needs Astropy, e.g., coordinate conversions, FITS file reading/writing, or cosmology calculations.

say_en.text: Convert ICRS coordinates to Galactic using SkyCoord.
say_en.note: Claude writes the conversion code and shows results.

say_en.text: Read image.fits, print header info and image mean.
say_en.note: Claude uses astropy.io.fits to read and summarize.

say_en.text: Compute comoving distance at z=2 with Planck18.
say_en.note: Claude calls the cosmology module and returns the distance.
